rv.q: It is an enthralling, titillating and wildly imaginative production.
Newly rebuilt Yard Theatre hosts a cheeky adult puppet show that is equal parts silly, sexy, poignant and surreal

The puppetry is novel with hilarious rough edges, Collins' text is vivid, and its critique of misogyny – while simply expressed and reinforced on multiple occasions – is thought-provoking and impactful.

cn.t: Critics praise this inventive dollhouse staging of Jackie Collins' debut novel, with its bold use of miniature puppetry to explore sexual dynamics proving both novel and provocative, though the unconventional approach has rough edges.
